systems.explanation: The circular name groups on the SALTS source use individually turned letterforms around open centers. The adaptation places input graphemes along a tangent-controlled arc; source names are not transcribed or claimed to be reconstructed. Confidence is a qualitative annotation, not a calibrated posterior; fitError is not an image-reconstruction metric.
invariants: Input grapheme order is preserved along the arc.
Glyphs share one em size and follow the physical tangent.
systems.name: Tangential glyph arc

systems.explanation: Visual inspection resolves the large Viti / Vini / Vici rows that OCR missed. The Vi prefix stays fixed while the terminal group changes. New input uses prefix|suffix|suffix; this is an annotated symbolic rule, not an OCR-derived exact fit. Confidence is a qualitative annotation, not a calibrated posterior; fitError is not an image-reconstruction metric.
invariants: The chosen prefix remains identical in every row.
Suffixes follow the explicit supplied sequence; total length may change.
systems.name: Protected prefix with cycling suffix

systems.explanation: The yellow-and-black source advances KUNSTKAMMER through three recurring tile columns. The adaptation keeps the ordered glyph staircase and a shared affine shear. The photographed projective folds and Q/G branding are not reconstructed. Confidence is a qualitative annotation, not a calibrated posterior; fitError is not an image-reconstruction metric.
invariants: One glyph occupies each successive row.
The column cycles modulo three while input order is retained.
All cells use the declared common affine treatment.
systems.name: Stepped glyph tiles
